description: This file defines a data transfer object (DTO) class 'HolidaySearchFilterParams' within the OrangeHRM leave plugin. It extends a date range search filter to include an 'exclude recurring' option for holiday search filtering.

classes.name: HolidaySearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO for filtering holiday searches with date range and optional exclusion of recurring holidays.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters and sets default sort field to 'holiday.date'.

methods.name: isExcludeRecurring
methods.description: Returns whether recurring holidays are excluded in the filter.

methods.name: setExcludeRecurring
methods.description: Sets the flag to exclude recurring holidays in the filter.
